breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided contradictory boundary conditions: both Neumann (u_x=0) and Dirichlet (u=0). The ground truth resolved this by keeping only the Neumann conditions. The agent's generated specification correctly identified and removed the contradictory Dirichlet condition, stating only 'The boundary conditions are Neumann conditions: u_x(0,t)=0 and u_x(1,t)=0', which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
